Adds a maintainable pricing alias registry so local model IDs can resolve to canonical OpenRouter pricing IDs instead of silently showing unpriced costs.

## What changed

- Centralized pricing alias resolution in `dashboard/pricing.py`.
- Added target aliases for Codex Spark and observed Antigravity Gemini model IDs.

- Added Hermes model reference URLs for session-accounted costs when the model ID can be resolved.
- Expanded tests for alias resolution, URL exposure, and UI link rendering.

- Confirm the alias decisions, especially `google/antigravity-gemini-3.1-pro* -> google/gemini-3.1-pro-preview`.

## Summary

- Add a local-only App Update control to the dashboard summary area.
- Add `/api/app-version` to check the current checkout against latest `origin/main` and report whether an update is available.
- Add localhost-only `POST /api/update` that refuses unsafe states, fast-forwards from `origin main`, runs `uv sync`, and reports restart-needed status.

## UX Notes

The dashboard shows one visible update control. It auto-detects whether latest `main` requires an update:

- `Up to Date` when current with `origin/main`
- `Update App` when a fast-forward update is available
- `Blocked` when an update exists but local changes would be overwritten
- `Manual Update` when the checkout cannot fast-forward cleanly

## Summary

The `preview` column was added to the Codex CLI `threads` table in a recent update. Older local `~/.codex/state_5.sqlite` databases lack this column, causing `/api/usage-history` and other Codex-backed endpoints to fail when the dashboard queries Codex data.

## Changes

- Split the Codex query into `_fetch_rows_with_preview()` and `_fetch_rows_without_preview()` helpers.
- Try the full query first; on `sqlite3.OperationalError` for missing `preview`, retry with the column-less query.
- Use `row.keys()` before reading `preview` in the title fallback path.
- Add regression coverage for an older Codex state schema without the `preview` column.

## Testing

- `uv sync`
- `uv run python -m unittest tests.test_app.DashboardApiTests.test_codex_records_support_older_state_without_preview_column -v`
- `scripts/review.sh` (32 tests pass; Python compilation passes)

Closes #29

## Summary

- Make Overview `Total Tokens` the intuitive full token volume including cache read/write.
- Rename the top-level input card from `Non-cache Input` to `Input Tokens` and show fresh/read/write breakdown in the secondary line.
- Show partial API-equivalent cost coverage as an amber `PARTIAL ESTIMATE` badge instead of muted footnote copy.
- Reorder top cards to put `Total Tokens` and cost first, move `Sessions` last, add cached-share percentage, and use `direct` for the visible session-token bucket.
- Add the `3d` quick range before `7d` in the top Usage date range controls.
- Preserve overview metric tooltip hover/focus/tap behavior by allowing stat-card overflow while keeping loading shimmer constrained.
- Keep session-token semantics explicit in details/docs/tests instead of using `Canonical`, `Effective`, or `Fresh` as top-level card language.
- Update simulated data, settings copy, README, AGENTS guidance, scope logs, and tests to lock the new formulas and UI order.

## Formulas

- `Total Tokens = non-cache input + output + cache read + cache write`
- `Input Tokens = non-cache input + cache read + cache write`
- `Output Tokens = assistant output`
- `Session Tokens = non-cache input + output`

## Fixes in latest update

- Include partial model costs (`partial_cost_usd`) in the Overview cost card total, not just fully priced models.
- When some models are only partially priced, show their known subtotal in the cost card tooltip metadata.
- Reduce simulated mode to a single `OpenCode (simulated)` source card so screenshots no longer show empty local `Codex CLI` / `Hermes` cards that have no simulated totals.
- Make `setCostMeta` distinguish fully priced vs partially priced models with an explicit `partialCount` argument.
- In all-partial scenarios, the badge still shows `Partial estimate` and the visible copy now says `6 partially priced of 6 models` instead of falsely saying `6 of 6 models priced`.
- In mixed scenarios, copy reads `X fully priced, Y partially priced of Z models`.
- Constrain loading shimmer styling to stat cards.
- Add `3d` before `7d` in the top range controls and assert the order in tests.
- Fix metric tooltip clipping by changing stat-card overflow back to visible and moving shimmer animation to `background-position`.

Latest patch: `606f079`

## Scope notes

- `PR22_REMAINING_SCOPE.md` tracks fixed vs deferred review items.
- `PR22_BEFORE_AFTER.md` records before/after UI changes and latest validation.
- Decision-guided Usage Summary and dashboard focus states remain split out to #23.

## Validation

- `uv run python -m unittest tests.test_app tests.test_readme -v`
- `scripts/review.sh`
- Browser smoke: `http://127.0.0.1:8321`
  - cards rendered in order as `Total Tokens`, `API-Equivalent Cost`, `Input Tokens`, `Output Tokens`, `Sessions`
  - range controls rendered in order as `3d`, `7d`, `30d`, `90d`, `All`
  - cost tooltip rendered visible, escaped the card bounds, and remained inside the viewport
  - cost card rendered `PARTIAL ESTIMATE` + model coverage copy
  - `Total Tokens` secondary line renders `direct`, cached raw volume, and cached-share percentage
  - `Input Tokens` secondary line renders `fresh`, `cache read`, and `cache write` buckets
  - browser console had no JS errors
- GitHub CI `test` passed on the previous head and is rerun/verified for the latest pushed head below.

Closes #20

body:
Make worktrees the default working mode so the `main` checkout stays clean and ready to receive merges.

## Why
`AGENTS.md` already said "prefer small reviewable PRs, do not push straight to main," but it had no concrete mechanism for keeping `main` clean. Sessions that touched feature branches often showed `.worktrees/` as untracked in the `main` checkout, and a worktree lived in the in-repo path for the duration of PR 14.

## What
- **AGENTS.md** (Working style): agents must work in a worktree, not the `main` checkout. Default location is outside the repo at `../worktrees/<branch-slug>`, with the worktree-add command shown verbatim.
- **AGENTS.md** (Repo conventions): keep `main` clean; retire worktrees with `git worktree remove`.
- **.gitignore**: add `.worktrees/` as a safety net for agents that use the in-repo path.
- **scripts/review.sh**: refuse to run from `main` unless `REVIEW_MODE=docs`; the error message points the agent at the worktree-add command.
- **tests/test_readme.py**: assert the new AGENTS.md guidance and the `.worktrees/` ignore line.
- **tests/test_app.py**: new `ReviewScriptGuardTests` class exercises the guard with a stubbed `git` binary, so the test stays self-contained and doesn't recurse into the suite it is testing.

## Verified
- `uv run python -m unittest tests.test_app tests.test_readme` → 31/31 OK
- `uv run python -m py_compile app.py scripts/snapshot_dashboard.py` → clean
- `scripts/review.sh` from this branch → "Full review mode complete"
- Guard check (run guarded `scripts/review.sh` from `main` in full mode) → exit 1 with the expected error message pointing at `git worktree add ../worktrees/<branch-slug> -b <branch> origin/main`
- Same call from `main` with `REVIEW_MODE=docs` → exit 0

## Out of scope
- Removing the existing in-repo worktree at `.worktrees/review-pr-14`. It pre-dates this rule and will be retired by the user separately.

body:
## Summary

Refine tool source provenance, chat copy, and chart filtering UX to match issue #5 requirements.

## Changes (4 commits)

### 1. Source copy + provenance + filter plumbing
- Tool source statuses: `Active source` (OpenCode) vs `Planned adapter` (Codex, Hermes)
- Repo links for all sources (OpenCode, Codex, Hermes)
- `/api/daily` now accepts `tool_id` filter + returns `selected_tool_id`/`selected_tool_label`
- Planned tool filters return empty chart + explicit error message
- Token cards: cache read/write shown as secondary lines; input/output cards reference cache separately
- Estimated cost secondary line: `approx · x/y priced` with hover explaining fallback logic
- Chart/tool filter exclusivity: selecting a model clears source filter, and vice versa

### 2. Restore source path visibility
- Tool Source cards now show `source_type` + `source_path` (DB path or `TBD`) on the metadata line
- Section subtitle also references source label/path

### 3. Stricter unknown tool contract
- Unknown `tool_id` → **HTTP 400** + `Unsupported tool_id: ...` error
- Known but not-connected sources → `200` + empty data + `planned and not connected` error

### 4. UI fetch failure guard
- `loadDaily()` now checks `response.ok`; non-OK responses render empty chart + server error in chart note
- Catch-all also sets empty chart state + `Failed to load chart data.`

## Reviewer checklist

| Area | What to verify |
|---|---|
| **Source labels** | `app.py` — OpenCode is `Active source`, Codex/Hermes are `Planned adapter` with `TBD` paths |
| **Source card metadata** | `templates/index.html` — each card shows `source_type · Source: <path>` and a `repo` link |
| **Token/cache wording** | Total secondary line shows cache read/write; input/output tooltips mention cache is excluded |
| **Tool filtering** | Clicking a tool card/name filters the chart; selecting a model clears tool filter and vice versa |
| **API contract** | `api_daily?tool_id=codex` → `200` + error; `tool_id=unknown` → `400` + error |
| **UI safety** | Non-OK fetch responses degrade gracefully (empty chart + error note) |
| **Tests** | `test_planned_tool_source_filter_returns_empty_daily_result`, `test_unknown_tool_source_filter_returns_http_400`, `test_tool_source_render_includes_path_handling` |

## Validation

```
uv run python -m unittest tests.test_app tests.test_readme -v
uv run python -m py_compile app.py scripts/snapshot_dashboard.py
scripts/review.sh
```
